description: React client infrastructure: Vite setup with React Router and Tailwind CSS, Axios instance with JWT interceptors, AuthContext for user state and token management, ProtectedRoute and AdminRoute components, Login and Register pages, Navbar with auth-aware links
steps: 1. Create client/package.json with dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, axios. DevDependencies: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer
3. Create client/vite.config.js - import react plugin, export config with plugins: [react()], server: { port: 5173 }
4. Create client/index.html - standard HTML5 template with div id='root' and script src='/src/main.jsx' type='module'
5. Create client/tailwind.config.js - configure content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{js,jsx}'], theme extend as needed, plugins: []
6. Create client/postcss.config.js - export config with plugins: { tailwindcss: {}, autoprefixer: {} }

7. Create client/src/index.css - Tailwind directives: @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; Add custom styles for consistent spacing, buttons, cards, form inputs, badges (status/category), and responsive layout

8. Create client/src/api/axios.js - Create axios instance with baseURL from import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL, request interceptor to attach Authorization: Bearer token from localStorage.getItem('token') if exists, response interceptor to catch 401 errors and redirect to /login (clear token from localStorage), export instance as default

9. Create client/src/context/AuthContext.jsx - Create context with user state, token state, login(token, user), logout(), register(token, user), loading state. On mount (useEffect), check localStorage for token, if exists call GET /api/auth/me to validate and fetch user, set user state or clear token if invalid. login/register: save token to localStorage and user to state. logout: remove token from localStorage, clear user state, redirect to /login. Export AuthProvider and useAuth hook
10. Create client/src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx - Use useAuth to check if user exists, if not redirect to /login with react-router Navigate, if yes render children (Outlet)
11. Create client/src/components/AdminRoute.jsx - Use useAuth to check if user exists and user.role === 'admin', if not redirect to / with Navigate, if yes render children (Outlet)

12. Create client/src/pages/Register.jsx - Form with name, email, password fields, onSubmit: POST /api/auth/register via axios, on success call register() from AuthContext with token and user, navigate to /. Show loading state, error messages from API. Link to /login

13. Create client/src/pages/Login.jsx - Form with email, password fields, onSubmit: POST /api/auth/login via axios, on success call login() from AuthContext, navigate to /. Show loading state, error messages. Link to /register

14. Create client/src/components/Navbar.jsx - Show app name/logo, links: Home (/), Roadmap (/roadmap). If authenticated: Create Post (/posts/create), Logout button. If not authenticated: Login, Register links. If admin, optionally show admin badge. Responsive mobile menu toggle
15. Create client/src/components/LoadingSpinner.jsx - Reusable spinner component using Tailwind (animate-spin)
16. Create client/src/components/ErrorMessage.jsx - Reusable error message component with prop for message, dismissable, styled with Tailwind

17. Create client/src/App.jsx - Wrap app in BrowserRouter and AuthProvider. Define Routes: / (public home/board), /login, /register, /roadmap (public), /posts/create (protected), /posts/:id (public), /posts/:id/edit (protected). Render Navbar outside routes. Use ProtectedRoute and AdminRoute wrappers where needed
18. Create client/src/main.jsx - Import React, ReactDOM, App, and index.css. Render App with React.StrictMode into document.getElementById('root')
19. Add scripts to client/package.json: 'dev': 'vite', 'build': 'vite build', 'preview': 'vite preview'
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd client && npm install' installs all dependencies without errors
Tailwind CSS is configured and styles are applied
Axios instance attaches JWT token to requests and handles 401 by redirecting to login
AuthContext provides user state, login, register, logout functions
AuthContext validates token on mount by calling /api/auth/me
Register page creates new user and logs them in automatically
Login page authenticates user and redirects to home
Logout clears token and user state
Navbar shows different links based on authentication state
LoadingSpinner and ErrorMessage components render correctly
verification: Run 'cd client && npm install' - should complete successfully
Copy client/.env.example to client/.env with VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000
Run 'cd client && npm run dev' - should start on port 5173
Open http://localhost:5173 - should see navbar and app
Click Register link, fill form, submit - should create account and redirect to home
Refresh page - should remain logged in (AuthContext fetches user)
Click Logout - should clear token and show login/register links
Click Login link, fill form, submit - should authenticate and redirect
Try to visit /posts/create without login - should redirect to /login
Login as admin, navigate to admin-only route (if any) - should allow access
Login as regular user, try same route - should redirect to /
Check Axios interceptor: make invalid request, verify 401 redirects to login
